summary: Human Resource Professional with a strong academic background in HR management and extensive experience in hiring, training, orientation, and employee development. Proven ability to manage large teams, develop policies, and implement effective recruitment strategies in fast‑growing organizations.

experience.title: HR Director
responsibilities: Communicated with diverse stakeholders while maintaining confidentiality.
Developed and implemented training programs for employee retention.
Authored and revised policies in compliance with federal, state, and county laws.
Pre‑screened candidates and matched skills to organizational needs.
Managed benefits eligibility and provided claimant support.
Delivered classroom and on‑the‑job training, workshops, and leadership development.
Oversaw hiring, disciplinary processes, and staff development.
Maintained employee data in recruiting databases and HRIS.
Acted as liaison between agency and media/advertising partners.
Coordinated new‑hire onboarding and orientation.
Handled payroll queries, benefits administration, and compliance with FMLA.
Facilitated employee grievance resolution and peer mediation.
Prepared employment data reports and recruitment analytics.

experience.title: Administrator
responsibilities: Managed administrative operations and staff coordination.
Implemented process improvements and maintained documentation.
Supported event planning and resource allocation.

experience.title: Event Specialist
responsibilities: Planned and executed events, coordinating logistics and vendors.
Managed budgets and tracked event expenses.
Engaged stakeholders and promoted event participation.

experience.title: Assistant Director
responsibilities: Assisted in organizational leadership and program oversight.
Developed staff training and development initiatives.
Managed operational budgets and compliance.
